subject: ClearBridge onboarding: model shortlist, context needs & token ramp plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Hayes <ellen.hayes@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@clearbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearBridge onboarding: model shortlist, context needs & token ramp plan

Hi Ellen / Luis,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great signal that the triage and summarization features are a match for your use cases. Per our conversation, I pulled together a concise handoff packet for implementation: a recommended model shortlist with pros/cons, suggested context-length profiles per endpoint, and a first-pass token ramp workbook for the first 90 days. See the two attachments (shortlist PDF + token_ramp workbook).

Top-line recommendations:
- Model shortlist: Falcon-40B-quant and Redstone-13B-qdq for primary QA/summarization endpoints; Redstone-7B for lightweight rerank and quick responses.
- Context windows: 8k for full-case summarization, 2k for short triage replies, 512 for micro-rerank.
- Initial token estimate: 1.1M tokens/month in month 1 (pilot), ramp to 6.5M tokens/month by month 3 under expected usage; see workbook for weekday/hourly peaks.

Ask from you: confirm the three endpoints we discussed (full-case summary, triage reply, rerank), and whether you have a hard SLA target for tail latency (p99) for the summarization endpoint. Also confirm any regulatory constraints that would push you to private deployment or require dedicated capacity.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm endpoints & SLA by EOD Mon (7/19).
2) Kickoff call with CS + Eng (30m) the week of 7/19 to lock in implementation plan and owners.
3) I’ll hand the packet to the implementation team (cc’d Ben, Grace, Marissa) after your confirmation.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Ellen Hayes <ellen.hayes@clearbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@clearbridge.com>, procurement@clearbridge.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: ClearBridge onboarding: model shortlist, context needs & token ramp plan

Jordan, thanks for the packet and the clear summary. I reviewed the shortlist and workbook with Luis. Quick clarifications:
- Endpoints: yes, those three are correct. We’ll probably add a lightweight classification endpoint later but that’s out of scope for the pilot.
- SLA: we need p95 < 600ms for quick triage, p99 target is 2.5s for full-case summarization if feasible. If p99 will require dedicated capacity, let us know so we can surface that in procurement.
- Data retention / compliance: we will need SOC 2 evidence and a sketch of how token-level logs can be redacted for PHI.

We can do a 30m kickoff on Tuesday 7/20 at 10am PT. Luis and I will bring our engineering lead and procurement rep. Please include whoever from your side owns the runtime & security checklist.

Thanks, Ellen

Subject: Fwd: ClearBridge onboarding: model shortlist, context needs & token ramp plan

Team — FYI, ClearBridge confirmed endpoints and proposed p99 SLA (see Ellen’s reply). Please review and help assemble the implementation checklist before the kickoff on 2027-07-20 10:00 PT. Key asks: SOC 2 evidence, PHI redaction approach, and whether p99 2.5s on 8k context requires Dedicated or can be met on Hosted with specific batching/config.

I started a short ops checklist below — please flag owners and missing items:
- Runtime owner (who will present architecture + fallback strategy) — @Ben
- Security/compliance quick summary (SOC 2 artifacts + KMS options) — @Grace
- Token ramp workbook review and model-cost delta by month (pilot -> month3) — @Marissa
- Suggested model variants & fallback routing plan (e.g., degrade to 7B during spikes) — @Ben / Marissa
- Prelim QA prompts for regression monitoring tied to the shortlist — @Grace

Ben: any initial thought on whether 8k summarization p99 2.5s is realistic on our hosted fleet for their projected traffic? If not, call out the likely capacity (dedicated pool) and an estimate.

Thanks — Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearBridge onboarding: model shortlist, context needs & token ramp plan

Jordan / team,

Quick take after a walkthrough of the workbook:
- If the monthly peak for full-case summaries is ~200 QPS at 8k context, hosted will likely struggle to meet p99 2.5s without aggressive batching and larger GPU instances; dedicated pool is the safer path for predictable p99 at that context window.
- Recommended pilot config: Dedicated pool with 2x A100-ish equivalents (or multi-GPU nodes with continuous batching enabled) + fallback to Redstone-7B on burst traffic. That keeps cost reasonable while preserving tail latency.
- For month 1 pilot (1.1M tokens/mo) we can run hosted comfortably; if ClearBridge ramps to 6M+/mo by month 3 and needs strict p99, we should suggest dedicated contract.

I’ll sketch a brief slide with capacity options and estimated monthly costs for the kickoff. Also will call out KV-cache strategy to shrink effective context for repeated references.

Ben
Senior Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: ClearBridge onboarding: model shortlist, context needs & token ramp plan — kickoff notes and owners

Ellen / Luis — thanks for the kickoff earlier today. Notes and owners below (short version):
- Runtime + capacity: Ben will provision a pilot hosted stack for month 1 and prepare a Dedicated capacity quote for p99 2.5s at 8k context by Thu 7/22. (Action: Ben)
- Security/compliance: Grace will share SOC 2 artifact locations and a recommended PHI redaction approach + transcript retention TTL options by Fri 7/23. (Action: Grace)
- Token ramp & cost modeling: Marissa will finalize the attached workbook with month-by-month cost deltas and a recommended commit level for month 3 based on the projected 6.5M tokens. (Action: Marissa)
- Contract/procurement: Jordan to introduce procurement contact to our sales contracts lead and surface dedicated pricing if required. (Action: Jordan)

Next milestone: internal sign-off on pilot config and procurement CTA by Mon 7/26 so ClearBridge can review SOW. Deliverables are linked in the Drive folder (see related links).

Thanks everyone — Jordan
